description: Synthetic: escrow ids, block hashes, block numbers and indexes are made up. Only the genesis hash is real (faucet GET /chain and tclk/flop/VERIFICATION.md). One event identity (same block hash and index) is read twice, once naming escrow a1 and once naming b2. One chain event is never evidence for two escrows, so both are unverified. Escrow c3 has its own clean release and stays claimed.
